book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Sataŋ gɛ̀ moŋ Jiso
Jiso gɛ̀ ja fɛ Joo yì Jodaŋ le, wù nyu wu yisɛ bɛ Kiyo ki Yuude. Ki jo wu wu ja wu gɛɛŋ wu chee nchvuuŋ.
Wu nyu yo yi aju le mbaanyɛ, debele mone wu. Wu gɛ̀ bee yo noo wu jii gɛ mwɛɛ gɛ. Aju ayu gɛ̀ fe, jɛŋ mo yi yuu wu.
Debele mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Wo nɛ le Mwa Nyo, wo dû tɛdɛ chinɛ chi tu blɛd.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Ba le ba saŋ lɛ,
‘Gɛ muh chee gɛh nje blɛd maa gɛ.’”

content: Debele jo wu wù bɛɛŋ bɛ wu kijusɛ kimi le fɛwɛɛwe, wu dunyɛ wu bituŋ bi yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le bichii. Jiso yɛŋ nɛ ŋwaaŋ.
Debele mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Ba le ba nya wa kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ kinɛ mɛne kichii, taŋlo nnya mo nyu yɛɛŋ wù ŋkoŋe le. Nlé nnyâ wo le wo sâge, wo kɛ̂me bvukugɛ bɛ bvuŋga bvuyu bvuchii.
Fi le gɛh lɛ wo tûŋ anyuu wo ŋgvûuŋ mɛ, mɛ mo nnya fiɛɛ fichii wo le.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Ba le ba saŋ lɛ,
‘Wo ŋgvûune Tada wu le Nyo wo,
wo lɛ̂ne gɛh nyu wu le maa.’”

content: Sataŋ mo wu jo wu wu gɛɛŋ bɛ wu a kinlaantɛŋ kì Yɛlusalɛm le, wu leesɛ wu fɛ kigo ki yeh yi kintanyɛ le, wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Wo nɛ le Mwa Nyo, wo selɛ fɛkuu,
nje fi le ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: ‘Nyo lé wu dû banchɛndaa be le lɛ bo chîɛɛŋ wo.’

content: Fi ka nyu ba saŋ lɛ,

content.text: ‘Bo lé bo gê bo kâŋ wo lɛ keefɛ wo kfûuŋ kikaa yi tɛdɛ le gɛ.’”

content: Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Ŋwa wu Nyo duu tɛ lɛ,
‘Keefɛ wo mône Tada wù Nyo wo gɛ.’”

content: Sege debele gɛ̀ mɛsɛ wa jé yichii yì wu gɛ taŋlo wu moŋ Jiso yu, wu mo wu ja wu gɛɛŋ wu chiɛɛne kife kimi.
Jiso kɛ lɛme che Galalee
Jiso ja wu tu jiŋ Galalee, wù nyu wu yisɛ bɛ bvuŋga bvu Kiyo ki Yuude. Saaka kune wu mo wu saaŋe wu gɛɛŋ bimbe bi woŋ wu yo le bichii.
Wu tu wu yɛyi bamii yéh yi buunɛ le, bamii bachii bɛɛŋse wu.
Ba faŋ Jiso ntɛ wuboo wu Nasalɛ le
Jiso mo wu ja wu gɛɛne ntɛ wu Nasalɛ a wu gɛ̀ ta yo. Lɛ to nyume juu chiboo chi yuuŋ, wu gɛɛŋ yeh yi buunɛ le gɛh no wu gɛ̀ shee wu gɛɛne. Wu gɛ̀ ja wu lɛɛŋ we ki wu tɛ̂ɛŋ Ŋwa wu Nyo.
Ba nya wu Ŋwa wù Yosaya wù muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ saŋ. Wu faanyɛ wu bijɛ kijusɛ kimi kì ba saŋ fo lɛ,

content.text: “Kiyo ki Tada Nyo le ye yaŋ le,
nje wu le wu yefɛ wa mɛ lɛ nto,
nfejɛ saaka wù joŋe bamii ba kifufe le.
Wu lé wu tûŋ mɛ lɛ nto,
ntefɛ bamii ba le yeh yi ncha le lɛ ba lé ba bvusɛ bo,
ŋka ntefɛ binfeeŋ lɛ bo lé bo yɛ̂ŋ mwɛɛ le.
Wu tuŋ tɛ mɛ lɛ nto mbvûsɛ bamii ba ba nyiɛge bɛ bo yeh yi ncha le,
ŋka nfêjɛ lɛ kiluŋ kinɛ, le kì Tada lé wu gê wu bvûsɛ bamii.”

content: No Jiso tɛŋe nɛ, wu kaasɛ wu kɛbɛ ŋwa wɛɛ wu nya muh wù to wu gɛɛde le wu mo wu shii fɛkuu. Bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ bee yeh yi buunɛ le bo tuŋ ajii ye ye le.
Wu mo wu kɛ wu naji bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Fiɛɛ finɛ fì bɛŋ yu a Ŋwa wu Nyo le, le fi to wa fi kojɛ abɛŋ.”

content: Bamii yegɛ fi joŋ bo le baaŋ, bo kɛme ŋgha yi njɛmɛ wù joŋe wù bude jwe we le. Bo mo bo ja bo maŋe, bo biide lɛ, “Wunɛ le gɛh mwa Yosɛf nɛ?”
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ maŋe lɛ bɛŋ lé bɛŋ mâ ŋgaŋ mɛne lɛ, ‘Muh wu fɛde bamii, fɛ̂ɛ la kikwɛɛ kuŋ.’ Bɛŋ dûu lɛ ŋgê tɛ mwɛɛ fɛnɛ mu bɛŋ chi yuge lɛ nchi ŋgee Kafanahum.”

content: Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, gɛ taŋlo ba ŋgvuuŋ muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo woŋ we le gɛ.

Yi nchiɛɛŋ le, nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ gɛ̀ bee kife ki muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wù Alaja le, jaŋ gɛ̀ she we yi biluŋ le bitɛde bɛ kii bvusoo, jɛŋ koo woŋ wuchii. Bakwɛŋkfu gɛ̀ bee woŋ wu Ishwala le kife kiyu le bo duude.
Geenɛ, Nyo gɛ̀ baaŋ tuŋ gɛ Alaja fɛ muh le a bo ntɛnɛɛ gɛ, wu tuŋ fie nyu fɛ kwɛŋkfu wù gɛ̀ bee Salafa le, woŋ wu Sidoŋ le.

Bɛŋ tane tɛ lɛ, gɛ̀ bee kife ki muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wù Ɛlisha le, bamii gɛ̀ bee Ishwala bo duude bo kɛme goŋ yì baaŋ, gɛ̀ muh lɛ bo le gɛ bonɛ gɛ. Gɛ̀ mɛ gɛh Nama wù woŋ wù Silia le wumaa wù ba gɛ̀ fɛ wu, wu yuu.”

content: No Jiso jɛme noo, bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ bee yeh yi buunɛ le yu, muntele bɛdɛ lo bo.
Bo ja we, bo doonɛ wu, bo bu bɛ wu a kinlaantɛŋ ki yu le, bo bɛɛŋ bo bu yi jwe wu kiŋkoŋ kì gɛ̀ bee yi mbegɛ le a ntɛ wuboo le, nje bo gɛ̀ goone ki bo doonɛ wu lɛ wu gwe yo.
Geenɛ, wu fe a bo ntɛnɛɛ wu gɛɛne fie.
Jiso bvusɛ kiyo kì yiide yi muh le
Jiso mo wu ja wu boh Kafanahum, ntɛ wumu wu Galalee le. Doo nyu juu chi yuuŋ, wu gɛɛŋ wu yɛyi bamii yeh yi buunɛ le.
Bamii bayu bachii bo yuge bo kɛme lo ŋgha yi n'yɛyɛ we le, nje n'yɛyɛ we gɛ̀ kɛme bvuŋga.
Muh mu gɛ̀ bee yeh yi buunɛ yiyu le, kiyo kì yiide nyu yi ye ye le. Wu mo wu ja wu waŋ lɛ,
“Abaay Jiso wu Nasalɛ, wo goone la a bee le? Wo to ki wo lɛ̂ɛshɛ lo bee? Ŋkee wo chuule. Le wo wɛɛ wù le muh wù yuude wù ja fɛ Nyo le.”
Jiso waŋ kiyo kì yiide kiyu, wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Baŋ lo, wo bu yi muh wunɛ le.”

content: Ki mo ki bɛ̂ɛŋsɛ muh wuyu ki tuŋ fɛkuu a bamii jii, ki mo ki bû ye ye le, geenɛ ki gɛ̀ baaŋ nya gɛ wu nfu gɛ.
Bamii bachii bijɛ, jwe yuŋ bo. Bo tu bo maŋe, bo biide lɛ, “Wunɛ njɛmɛ le wu nɛɛ wù muh wunɛ kɛme? Wu kɛme bvuŋga bvù baaŋ bvù wu wame biyo bì yiide bi bude ye yi bamii le.”
Saaka wu kune Jiso jiɛnyɛ bantɛ bachii ba le kimbe ki yo le.
Jiso fɛ bamii ba duude
Jiso gɛ̀ ja wu bu yeh yi buunɛ yɛɛ le, wu gɛɛŋ wu lee a Samoŋ yeh. Gɛ̀ bee mwɛɛdɛ Samoŋ chɛne bɛ kin'ya. Bo lɛgɛ lɛ Jiso fih wu.
Wu gɛɛŋ fɛ wu gɛ̀ gime fo, wu lɛɛŋ a wu we, wu waŋ kin'ya kiyu, ki chinɛ wu le wu tɛmɛ. Kimimia, kwɛse wɛɛ mo wu ja we wu bijɛ fiɛɛ bo ji.
Juu gɛ̀ doo chi seele, bamii ba gɛ̀ kɛme bamii ba chɛne bɛ binchɛŋ yeye yeye bo mo jode bo bachii bo too bɛ bo fɛ Jiso le. Wu mo wu kune bo le bachii, bo tɛɛme.
Banchɛndaa ba Sataŋ gɛ̀ bude ye yi bamii bamu ba duude le tɛ bo wanɛ lɛ, “Wo le Mwa Nyo.” Geenɛ, Jiso lejɛ lɛ keefɛ bo jɛ̂me gɛ, nje bo gɛ̀ kee lɛ Jiso le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka.
Akfuuŋ gɛ̀ bu ayuu, Jiso bu wu gɛɛŋ kijusɛ kimi le wu maa. Bamii gɛ̀ shɛɛ bo kɛ bo goone wu. Bo doo bo to bo yɛŋ wu le, wu goone wa lɛ wu ja ntɛ wɛɛ le. Bo mo bo goone jé lɛ wu mɛ bɛ bo.
Geenɛ, wu faŋ wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Ŋkɛme ki nfêjɛ saaka wù joŋe kune bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo bantɛ bamu le tɛ, nje le fiɛɛ fì Nyo tuŋ mɛ lɛ nto ŋge.”

content: Wu mo wu ja wu gɛɛŋ wu jiɛnyi wu feeji saaka wɛɛ yéh yi buunɛ le, woŋ kwɛɛ le wuchii.
